image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a stack of audio cassette tapes. The primary subject is a black cassette tape in the foreground with a white label featuring handwritten text and blue marker lines. Behind it are other cassettes, including one with a green spine label and another black one above the main subject. The image has a shallow depth of field, blurring the background items.

artifact_observations.location: White label on the foreground cassette
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the label mimics handwriting but lacks legible character structure. It appears as 'alien script' or smeared ink, typical of AI generation struggling with fine text rendering.
The plastic surface lacks the sharp specular highlights and micro-scratches expected from real aged plastic. It has a slightly 'waxy' or overly smooth diffuse appearance.
The edges of the paper label blend slightly into the plastic casing rather than sitting distinctly on top, suggesting minor boundary bleeding.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is taxonomically a cassette and not a similar rectangular object (e.g., VHS adapter, hard drive).
To rigorously analyze the illegibility of the text and determine if it constitutes a significant artifact.
To check for fusion between the stacked cassettes and ensure the label is a distinct topological entity from the shell.
To assess the realism of the plastic texture and lighting consistency.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of text on the label
Sharpness of boundaries between stacked objects
Geometric correctness of the spool windows
